title: SafePearl
description: Pearl your way safely through the world.
body:
# SafePearl

![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/mB6HAeMg) ![Environment](https://img.shields.io/badge/Environment-Client-purple) ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.6%E2%80%931.21.11-brightgreen)

## Never die to an ender pearl again.

SafePearl is a lightweight, **client-side** Fabric mod that shows you exactly where your ender pearl will land — and stops you from throwing one that would get you killed. Works on **any server**, no server-side install needed.

## ✨ Features

- 🎯 **See where your pearl lands** — a live trajectory trail and a marker on the exact block you'll hit, using the game's *real* pearl physics (it even accounts for running, sprinting, falling, and throwing from water).
- 🛡️ **Deadly-throw guard** — if a throw would kill you (lava, the void, a lethal fall), SafePearl cancels it *before the pearl leaves your hand*. No pearl wasted, no cooldown. Hold **sneak to override**.
- ❤️ **Damage prediction** — shows the hearts you'll lose before you throw, using your actual health, fall distance, and effects like Slow Falling, Feather Falling, and soft landings (water, slime, hay).
- 📟 **Compact HUD** under your crosshair: safety status, damage, and distance at a glance.

## 🚦 Safety verdict

| Verdict | Meaning |
|---------|---------|
| 🟢 **SAFE** | Solid ground, negligible fall. |
| 🟠 **RISKY** | You'll survive, but take some fall damage. |
| 🔴 **DEADLY** | Lava, the void, or a lethal fall — the throw is blocked by default. |

## ⚙️ Configuration

Open the settings through **Mod Menu** — toggle the trail, markers, HUD, and the deadly-throw guard, and tune every colour and threshold. Everything saves to `config/safepearl.json`.

## 📦 Install

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).
2. Drop SafePearl into your `mods` folder.
3. *(Optional)* Add [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) to access the in-game settings.

Supports Minecraft **1.21.6 – 1.21.11**.
